title: Acceptance from a satisfying CNF assignment
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let an assignment of signs be given to the $n$ input coordinates and the gate coordinates. If this assignment satisfies the width-three CNF associated with $C$, then $C$ accepts the input whose bits are obtained by interpreting its input-coordinate signs as Boolean values.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
The assignment evaluates the width-three CNF associated with $C$ to $-1$
